Faults:
NO track on Display
and No PD count
available
Possible Cause:
No RF available at the
input of DIFM
Corrective action:
Verify DIFM input frequency
on spectrum analyzer and if
not available, check the I/P
RF at J13 and J14 ports of
AHU-4

Faults:
No track on Display
but PD count
present
Possible Cause:
One of the videos may
not be available from
AHU-3 (I/P of TDOA
board)
Corrective action:
Verify videos (CH1, CH2,
CH3 and CH4) at input of
TDOA board on Oscilloscope

Possible Cause:
Processor Boards
(ESMP-PPD2 or RPB)
may be faulty.
Corrective action:
Ping 192.168.5.91 (ESMP –
PPD2), 192.168.5.10
(RPB).If any IP address is
not pinging, Replace the
module.

Possible Cause:
There may be an issue
in the FO link
connectivity
Corrective action:
Check FO cable connectivity
to RPB board (all the 4 ports
A1, B1 & A2, B2)

Possible Cause:
Type-III BITE unit
output may not be
available
Corrective action:
Monitor Type-3 BITE source
output RF (24 & 36 GHz) at
output port of AHU4 on
spectrum analyzer based on
the sector selection from
SCD (J16, J18 & J22 for 45°,
225° and J16, J20 and J24
for 135°, 315°)

Track is available
with wrong Band
code (18-29 GHz

RF cable Connectivity
issue between Omni
MASS and Omni
Receivers
Corrective action:

connectivity between Omni
Receiver and Omni MASS
